description: Monitors GitHub Copilot usage and performance via Application Insights OpenTelemetry data. Tracks agent operations, LLM token consumption, model latency (response duration and time-to-first-token), chat sessions, tool calls, feature adoption, and errors. Includes trace drill-down for debugging individual Copilot interactions. Adds reported token costs in USD using Copilot's token-priced AI credits: 1 billion nano-AIU = 1 AI credit = $0.01. These amounts represent usage value before included credits, not invoice charges.

panels.description: Agent runs are invoke_agent spans (one per user turn in VS Code agent mode; one per Copilot CLI process or sub-agent run). Token totals are the per-run roll-ups reported on those spans, so model requests made outside an agent run (inline chat, Next Edit Suggestions, commit messages) are not included here — see the Token Efficiency row for all requests. AI Usage Units sums the usage units each client reports per request (github.copilot.nano_aiu for Copilot CLI, copilot_chat.copilot_usage_nano_aiu for VS Code, divided by 1e9). Reported token cost converts valid reported units to USD at $0.01 per AI credit, without rounding the units first. Copilot supplies the model and cache-tier pricing. Missing or negative usage units are excluded from cost, not treated as free usage; see cost reporting coverage in the model table. This is usage value before included credits, not an invoice total. github.copilot.cost is not used because it is a flat 1 per CLI request.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let usage = materialize(
    dependencies
    | where cloud_RoleName in (${source:singlequote})
    | where tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.operation.name"]) == "chat"
    | extend aiu = coalesce(
        todouble(customDimensions["github.copilot.nano_aiu"]) / 1e9,
        todouble(customDimensions["copilot_chat.copilot_usage_nano_aiu"]) / 1e9)
    | summarize Aiu = sum(aiu),
        TokenCost = iff(countif(aiu >= 0) > 0, sumif(aiu, aiu >= 0) * 0.01, real(null)));
dependencies
| where cloud_RoleName in (${source:singlequote})
| where tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.operation.name"]) == "invoke_agent"
| extend
    input_tokens = tolong(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]),
    output_tokens = tolong(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"])
| summarize
    Runs = count(),
    InputTokens = sum(input_tokens),
    OutputTokens = sum(output_tokens),
    AvgRunSec = round(avg(duration) / 1000, 2)
| project
    ['AI Usage Units'] = round(toscalar(usage | project Aiu), 1),
    ['Reported token cost'] = toscalar(usage | project TokenCost),
    ['Agent Runs'] = Runs,
    ['Agent Input Tokens'] = InputTokens,
    ['Agent Output Tokens'] = OutputTokens,
    ['Avg Agent Run Duration'] = AvgRunSec

panels.title: Agent Summary Statistics

panels.description: LLM Calls counts model requests (chat spans) from both sources, including Copilot CLI requests that never received a response (broken out in the Errors & Reliability row) but excluding sub-agent roll-up spans. Chat Sessions are distinct copilot_chat.chat_session_id (VS Code) / gen_ai.conversation.id (CLI). Reasoning Calls are measured requests with reasoning content (VS Code) or reasoning output tokens (CLI). Avg TTFT uses copilot_chat.time_to_first_token (VS Code, ms) or gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk (CLI, seconds converted to ms).

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where cloud_RoleName in (${source:singlequote})
| extend
    op = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.operation.name"]),
    hasModel = isnotempty(customDimensions["gen_ai.response.model"]),
    measured = isnotempty(customDimensions["copilot_chat.time_to_first_token"])
        or isnotempty(customDimensions["gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk"])
        or isnotempty(customDimensions["github.copilot.server_duration"]),
    isReasoning = isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["copilot_chat.reasoning_content"]))
        or tolong(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens"]) > 0,
    sessId = coalesce(
        tostring(customDimensions["copilot_chat.chat_session_id"]),
        tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.conversation.id"])),
    ttft = coalesce(
        todouble(customDimensions["copilot_chat.time_to_first_token"]),
        todouble(customDimensions["gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk"]) * 1000)
| summarize
    ['LLM Calls'] = countif(op == "chat" and (measured or not(hasModel))),
    ['Chat Sessions'] = dcountif(sessId, isnotempty(sessId)),
    ['Tool Calls'] = countif(op == "execute_tool"),
    ['Reasoning Calls'] = countif(op == "chat" and measured and isReasoning),
    ['Avg TTFT'] = round(avgif(ttft, op == "chat" and isnotnull(ttft)), 0)

panels.title: Agent Run Duration by Source and Agent

panels.description: Token usage per model. Totals cover every chat span with a recorded response model, including Copilot CLI sub-agent roll-up spans (a sub-agent run's usage is recorded as one span, so its model shows tokens but few or no measured requests). Requests, per-request averages and the cache hit rate use measured requests only. Cached input tokens (gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens) are always a subset of input tokens. Reported token cost uses Copilot's reported nano-AIU: divide by 1e9 for AI credits, then multiply by $0.01 for USD. This includes the model and cache-tier pricing reported by Copilot, before included credits. Cost reporting is the percentage of these chat spans with nonnegative usage units. Unreported spans do not erase known costs, and a model with no reported cost shows Not reported. See https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/concepts/billing-and-usage/organizations-and-enterprises/billing.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where cloud_RoleName in (${source:singlequote})
| where tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.operation.name"]) == "chat"
| where isnotempty(customDimensions["gen_ai.response.model"])
| extend model = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.response.model"]),
    measured = isnotempty(customDimensions["copilot_chat.time_to_first_token"])
        or isnotempty(customDimensions["gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk"])
        or isnotempty(customDimensions["github.copilot.server_duration"]),
    inputTokens = tolong(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]),
    outputTokens = tolong(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"]),
    cacheRead = tolong(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens"]),
    aiu = coalesce(
        todouble(customDimensions["github.copilot.nano_aiu"]) / 1e9,
        todouble(customDimensions["copilot_chat.copilot_usage_nano_aiu"]) / 1e9)
| summarize Requests = countif(measured),
    TotalInputTokens = sum(inputTokens),
    TotalOutputTokens = sum(outputTokens),
    MeasuredInput = sumif(inputTokens, measured),
    MeasuredCached = sumif(cacheRead, measured),
    AvgInputPerRequest = round(avgif(inputTokens, measured), 0),
    AvgOutputPerRequest = round(avgif(outputTokens, measured), 0),
    ['Reported token cost'] = iff(countif(aiu >= 0) > 0, sumif(aiu, aiu >= 0) * 0.01, real(null)),
    ['Cost reporting %'] = round(100.0 * countif(aiu >= 0) / count(), 1)
    by model
| extend ['Cache Hit %'] = iff(MeasuredInput > 0, round(100.0 * MeasuredCached / MeasuredInput, 1), real(null)),
    AvgInputPerRequest = iff(Requests > 0, AvgInputPerRequest, real(null)),
    AvgOutputPerRequest = iff(Requests > 0, AvgOutputPerRequest, real(null))
| project model, ['Reported token cost'], ['Cost reporting %'], Requests, TotalInputTokens, TotalOutputTokens, ['Cache Hit %'], AvgInput = AvgInputPerRequest, AvgOutput = AvgOutputPerRequest
| order by TotalInputTokens desc

panels.description: Model requests (chat spans) by outcome. Completed: a response model and a latency attribute were recorded. No response recorded: Copilot CLI chat spans that ended without a response model, tokens or output (status unset, success true) — cancelled or superseded requests whose outcome is unknown; they are not counted as failures. Failed: success = false. Sub-agent roll-up spans, which are not requests, are excluded.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where cloud_RoleName in (${source:singlequote})
| where tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.operation.name"]) == "chat"
| extend hasModel = isnotempty(customDimensions["gen_ai.response.model"]),
    measured = isnotempty(customDimensions["copilot_chat.time_to_first_token"])
        or isnotempty(customDimensions["gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk"])
        or isnotempty(customDimensions["github.copilot.server_duration"])
| where not(hasModel and not(measured))
| extend outcome = case(
    tobool(success) == false, "Failed",
    not(hasModel), "No response recorded",
    "Completed")
| summarize Count = count() by bin(timestamp, $__interval), outcome
| order by timestamp asc
